meta.expect: Moves one position at a time on evidence, ends at the rewrite to put this behind him; debrief Where she ended says fair outcome; What she never said names the laptop and how close the 11:31 PM times came

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
Before anything else: I entered the zero before I called you. That broke procedure 4.2, and I'm sorry Owen found out on his phone.
Okay. Now tell me what you based the zero on.
Here's the version history. Created Wednesday, October 28, 11:31 PM, title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words in one edit. At 11:58 PM, 794 more. No earlier drafts. Turn the screen, read it yourself.

Students draft somewhere else and paste it in, so all that shows is when the text arrived, not who wrote it. I'm writing down those times. Was Owen asked about any of this before you entered the zero?
If he drafted somewhere else, he can bring me that file with its dates, and I'll look at it with you.

You still haven't said whether Owen was heard before that zero went in. Whatever happens next, none of this goes on his record, and it stays between us and him, not his class. Is anything on his file right now?
Second: the essay quotes a line from Act 3, Scene 2 that is not in the play. Here's the act. Search it.
Seventeen-year-olds misquote from memory, and editions differ. Which edition is that, and is it the one you assigned the class?
Third: his in-class writing from September 24. 380 words in 40 minutes, comma splices, no quotations. The essay has nine quotations cited by act, scene and line, and no errors.
Forty minutes in class against a take-home essay he had days to polish is not a comparison, it's two different tasks. And you skipped my question. Which edition?

Under 4.4 this is a first concern. I'm offering a supervised rewrite, private, not in front of his class. If it shows the learning, its mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.

To put this behind him, Owen will do the rewrite, and only on those terms. Tonight's email says private, the new mark replaces the zero, nothing on his file, and the rewrite happens before the end of next week, because his scholarship applications close December first. And you still owe me that edition.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
To: Hale
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

You agreed today that Owen will do a private supervised rewrite under procedure 4.4, that its mark replaces the zero, and that nothing goes on his record. I still require that rewrite to happen before the end of next week, and an answer on which edition of the play you checked his quotation against. I expect the written confirmation you promised tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite whose mark replaces the zero with nothing on his file; she still wants it held before the end of next week and still wants to know which edition you checked, and this is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: You showed the version history with exact times, then answered her claim that he drafted elsewhere by inviting Owen to bring that file with its dates, which gave her something dated and checkable she could not wave away.
What cost ground: You twice skipped her questions, first whether Owen was heard before the zero and then which edition you used, which made her sharper and left her an open point to take upstairs.
What she never said: One night in October she came downstairs at 1 AM, saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the essay's text arriving just before midnight on October 28, close enough in kind to that memory to make her go harder at procedure, though it proves nothing about the essay and is only why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked whether Owen was heard before the zero went in, answer it plainly in one sentence, because leaving it open hands her the procedure argument she would use with the principal.
